name: @local/media-bridge
description: Voice and media bridge that calls exactly one upstream per request: subscription plans first (MiniMax M Plan, Qwen Token Plan), then pay-as-you-go in order Xiaomi (free), DeepSeek, MiniMax, Qwen. Provider and model are selectable, the per-capability order is editable by drag on the Settings page, and a failure returns a structured code so the caller decides whether to switch or retry, since image and video calls bill even on a timeout.
